shadows.name: workspace-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift the single active workspace object from the measured canvas.

shadows.name: drawer-lift
shadows.purpose: Separate a temporary Activity or History drawer from the current work.

motion.name: drawer-in
motion.purpose: Introduce a requested drawer without slowing the task.

motion.name: voice-energy
motion.purpose: Map measured PCM energy to the agent body and waveform.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #16a34a; color: #fff; font: 650 11px Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #12823d; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Message Field
components.description: Accepts a typed command before microphone permission.
components.css: .ds-message { height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #d6dae1; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #151923; font: 400 12px Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-message:focus { border-color: #2563eb; outline: 2px solid #eef4ff; }

components.name: Workspace Tabs
components.description: Switches among Documents, Sheets, Planner, Research, and Settings.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 7px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6eb; background: #fff; } .ds-tab { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #6e7686; font: 650 11px Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-active { background: #f7f8fa; color: #151923; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Artifact Row
components.description: Selects a file and exposes its local actions.
components.css: .ds-artifact { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 34px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 6px 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6eb; border-left: 3px solid #2563eb; background: #eef4ff; color: #202532; font: 400 11px Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-artifact span { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-artifact small { color: #6e7686; } .ds-artifact button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #6e7686; }

components.name: Change Receipt
components.description: Groups a coordinated agent update behind one undo control.
components.css: .ds-receipt { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 13px; border-radius: 9px; background: #eaf8ef; color: #151923; font: 400 11px Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-receipt span { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-receipt small { color: #6e7686; } .ds-receipt button { min-height: 30px; border: 1px solid #d6dae1; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #202532; }

narrative.overview: TalkOS feels like a calm productivity tool rather than a chat dashboard. A compact direct exchange and reactive agent occupy the left rail; one native-feeling work surface dominates the rest.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral surfaces, a quiet measured canvas, and restrained state color.
Humanist interface type with monospaced data only where precision helps.
Flat application chrome surrounding one gently elevated working object.
Motion tied to live voice energy, interruption, and drawer transitions.

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Green, blue, and red explain state; they never decorate empty space.

rules.name: The Quiet-Type Rule
rules.body: Interface labels stay compact; working content receives the room and contrast.

rules.name: The One-Object Rule
rules.body: A workspace view lifts one working object; internal sections use rules and tonal surfaces rather than nested cards.

dos: Do keep the working surface larger than the agent rail.
Do keep interruptions, revision conflicts, coordinated changes, and undo visible.
Do use familiar editor, spreadsheet, schedule, menu, and export affordances.
donts: Don't introduce glass, glow, fake metrics, or decorative dashboard tiles.
Don't keep conversation history, research context, or activity permanently open.
Don't turn human keystrokes into agent activity noise.
